{"query":"SELECT TOP 5001 mu.mukey, mu.mupolygonkey,
mu.mupolygongeo.STIntersection(geometry::STGeomFromText('POLYGON ((-103.15450398326661 40.13584598801245, -103.15167052680775 40.136007071283984, -103.15188416728286 40.138143122882035, -103.1547177077445 40.13798203462627, -103.15450398326661 40.13584598801245))',4326)).STAsText() AS intersection_wkt,
l.areasymbol, CAST(sa.saverest AS varchar(30)) AS survey_version,
c.cokey,c.comppct_r,c.hydgrp,c.drainagecl,
h.chkey,h.hzdept_r,h.hzdepb_r,h.claytotal_r,h.sandtotal_r,h.silttotal_r,h.om_r,h.ph1to1h2o_r,h.awc_r
FROM mupolygon mu INNER JOIN mapunit m ON m.mukey=mu.mukey

WHERE mu.mupolygongeo.STIntersects(geometry::STGeomFromText('POLYGON ((-103.15450398326661 40.13584598801245, -103.15167052680775 40.136007071283984, -103.15188416728286 40.138143122882035, -103.1547177077445 40.13798203462627, -103.15450398326661 40.13584598801245))',4326))=1 AND h.hzdept_r<100 AND h.hzdepb_r>0
